verdict.rationale: Synctera publishes an API reference (links such as /v2/reference/createinternaltransfer), serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json, and issues Sandbox API keys so integrators can 'immediately start calling the APIs'. Nothing in the evidence shows that the reference itself is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it console in the reference, runnable code examples, hands-on corroboration of in-browser execution against Sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The [Internal Transfer API](/v2/reference/createinternaltransfer) allows you to transfer funds between two Synctera accounts, in real-time.
Once an API key is issued in Sandbox, you can immediately start calling the APIs below.
